races.paceDynamic: Thecoffeepoddotco is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the rail, likely getting an uncontested lead with Addarella and Savannah Smiles settling just behind in prominent positions. With four of six runners adopting hold-up tactics (Silver Wraith, Moe's Legacy, Correspondence all need cover), the lack of early pressure allows the pace angle to control the race rhythm. This race shape clearly favours front runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace without having to make up significant ground.

races.paceDynamic: Law Of Average and Connie's Rose will contest the early lead in this small field, with both confirmed front-runners likely to set a solid gallop over the minimum trip. The firm ground and 5f distance means the pace will be honest from the start, with little room for tactical maneuvering. With only six runners and two natural leaders, the hold-up horses (Cayman Tai, Rogue Bullet, Some Nightmare) will need to be positioned closer than usual to have any chance. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and horses with early speed, as those settling behind the pace will struggle to make up ground in such a small field over this sharp distance.

scenarios.body: The two leaders will set genuine pace that suits their front-running styles, with the winner coming from this pair. Connie's Rose has superior course form with two wins at this track and distance, while Law Of Average drops significantly in grade.

scenarios.body: Rogue Bullet or Cayman Tai could benefit from a steadier tempo that allows their hold-up style to be effective. The small field means they won't be too far back even from their usual patient tactics.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Special
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners completely fold leaving race wide open
scenarios.body: Some Nightmare's veteran experience could prove decisive if the pace setters capitulate completely. His turf record is strong and the light weight would help in a slowly-run finish.

races.paceDynamic: Endofastorm is the only confirmed front-runner in this 7-runner field and should get an easy lead without pace pressure. With six hold-up horses behind him, the pace will be steady to moderate through the early stages, allowing tactical horses like Eutropia and Silkies Sib to settle well. The lack of early pace means the race will likely become a sprint from the 3f pole when the field closes up behind the leader. This sustainable pace scenario strongly favours horses with a sharp turn of foot who can quicken off steady fractions, giving the edge to late-running types with proven acceleration.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If Endofastorm sets uncontested fractions and the field remains bunched turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a test of who has the sharpest kick when the tempo lifts late, suiting horses like Eutropia who thrived off similar pace at Lingfield. Hold-up horses with proven acceleration will have every chance to unleash their finishing speed.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.body: His two-day turnaround could work in his favour if the pace stays honest, and his runner-up effort here on Monday suggests he's found form. The prominent runner could prove hard to peg back if he kicks clear approaching the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Slow Burn
scenarios.trigger: If the lack of early pace creates a stop-start rhythm with multiple horses making their moves simultaneously
scenarios.body: This tactical affair would favour the most experienced campaigners who can find gaps and time their runs, with Chourmo's class edge potentially telling. Horses drawn poorly or caught in traffic will struggle in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Endofastorm fails to handle the quick turnaround or doesn't lead as expected
scenarios.body: The race would become even more tactical with no obvious leader, creating a crawling pace that could set up any horse with a decent turn of foot. This chaos scenario would be hardest to predict but could suit an improver like Whiteley Way.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Endofastorm fails to take up the running early, as this would create a leaderless race with unpredictable pace dynamics

With six hold-up horses behind her, the pace will be steady early before intensifying from the 3f pole as the field closes in. The tactical shape strongly favours front-running Lady Lauren who can dictate terms, while the hold-up horses face the challenge of making up ground against a horse with first run on firm ground. races.paceDynamic: Fact Or Fable will lead unchallenged early, setting a sustainable gallop on this firm ground over Bath's demanding 1m circuit. Behind him, Brinton, Scenario, Man Is King, and Huntly Lodge will jostle for prominent positions, creating congestion and tactical complications approaching the home turn. The real danger emerges 2-3 furlongs out when the hold-up horses—Havana Club, Simba's Gift, Too Much Trevor, and others—launch their challenges simultaneously into limited racing room. This pace setup strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can secure good positions early and avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will compromise late-running horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Sustains
scenarios.trigger: If Fact Or Fable maintains his lead without serious early pressure and the pace stays honest.
scenarios.body: The 9-year-old veteran uses his C&D experience and tactical advantage to hold off late challenges, while prominent runners like Brinton and Scenario benefit from tracking the solid gallop. Hold-up horses get caught in traffic as multiple runners converge late.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and creates gaps for the better hold-up horses to exploit, particularly Havana Club who won over C&D last year. Scenario's recent C&D winner form gives her the edge in a sustained drive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Traffic
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses early and becomes a sprint finish with multiple hold-up runners converging.
scenarios.body: Havana Club's class advantage shows as he navigates the inevitable congestion better than rivals, while Too Much Trevor and Simba's Gift get blocked at crucial moments. The tactical mess favours experience and racing luck.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If the exposed handicappers underperform and competitive maidens find improvement.
scenarios.body: Huntly Lodge or Too Much Trevor finally break their maiden status in a race where the favorites fail to fire on firm ground. The 56-day break works in Huntly Lodge's favor as the lesser-exposed runner finds significant improvement.

races.paceDynamic: Grand Harbour and Weston Court will contest the early lead in this small field, with both having confirmed front-running styles but neither possessing the tactical speed to get away from the field. The honest early pace they set will suit the prominent runners like Havana Mojito and Eye Of The Water to track just behind, while the hold-up horses face the challenge of finding gaps in a compact field of nine. On firm ground over Bath's straight mile, this setup clearly favours prominent runners who can position close enough to strike when the leaders tire, rather than hold-up horses who need more pace collapse than this race will provide.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.body: The prominent runners get first run on the tiring leaders while hold-up horses are still making ground from too far back. Eye Of The Water and Havana Mojito are perfectly placed to capitalize when Grand Harbour and Weston Court begin to weaken.

scenarios.body: The strong early pace sets up perfectly for the closers who can pick up the pieces in the final two furlongs. Oasis Sunrise gets her preferred scenario while Baynoona can use her sole course and distance win as a blueprint.

scenarios.body: The front-runner can dictate terms and kick clear when they choose, leaving the field chasing shadows. Grand Harbour's better recent form gives him the edge over Weston Court who has been struggling.

scenarios.body: The race becomes messy with horses getting in each other's way, allowing an outsider to slip through. Redhot Whisper showed some form last time while Clipsham Noble could benefit from the move to new connections.
